title: Benchmarking Open-ended Audio Dialogue Understanding for Large Audio-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of references and generated responses in the LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4) evaluation prompts and comparing the resulting scores to measure the evaluator's undue preference based on text position.

Comparing the evaluation scores produced by GPT-4 with human judgments and scores from other open-source LLMs (LLaMA-3-70B-Instruct and Qwen-2-72B-Instruct) to identify and mitigate bias stemming from relying on a single LLM-as-a-judge.

Evaluating model performance on audio dialogue understanding across 9 different languages (e.g., English, Chinese, Arabic, French, etc.) to highlight capability disparities stemming from English-dominated training data versus other linguistic contexts.
